propositions: Bridge must transition from continuous self-dispatch to a single hourly cron entry (23 * * * *) to free the runner after RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS is set false

The cadence test must be retargeted to derive fire times from the cron and assert exactly 60-minute gaps, a single schedule entry, and a non-zero minute rather than echoing a literal or checking multiple entries

The CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm must be retuned from (threshold=1, evaluation_periods=1) to (threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2) so it remains firable at hourly cadence and detects sustained failures over ~2 hours
All references to 40-minute cadence in comments, docstrings, workflow headers, and documentation must be updated to reflect the new hourly schedule and 1-hour worst-case latency
A terraform apply is required to deploy the monitoring alarm retune; Terraform Drift will remain red until applied, and the deployed alarm is unalarmed until the change is applied
